 *
 * @return void
 */

	register_post_type(
		POST_TYPE,
		array(
			'labels'          => array(
				'name'                  => __( 'Team Members', 'team-directory' ),
				'singular_name'         => __( 'Team Member', 'team-directory' ),
				'menu_name'             => __( 'Team Directory', 'team-directory' ),

				'new_item'              => __( 'New Team Member', 'team-directory' ),
				'view_item'             => __( 'View Team Member', 'team-directory' ),
				'search_items'          => __( 'Search Team Members', 'team-directory' ),
				'not_found'             => __( 'No team members found.', 'team-directory' ),
				'not_found_in_trash'    => __( 'No team members found in Trash.', 'team-directory' ),

				'set_featured_image'    => __( 'Set photo', 'team-directory' ),
				'remove_featured_image' => __( 'Remove photo', 'team-directory' ),
				'use_featured_image'    => __( 'Use as photo', 'team-directory' ),
			),
			'public'          => true,
			'has_archive'     => false,
			'rewrite'         => array( 'slug' => 'team' ),
			'menu_icon'       => 'dashicons-groups',
			'show_in_rest'    => true,
			'rest_base'       => 'team-members',
			'capability_type' => 'post',
			'map_meta_cap'    => true,
			'supports'        => array( 'title', 'editor', 'thumbnail', 'excerpt', 'custom-fields', 'revisions' ),
			'template'        => array(
				array(
					'core/paragraph',
					array( 'placeholder' => __( 'Write a short bio…', 'team-directory' ) ),
				),
			),
		)
	);

	$auth_callback = static function ( $allowed, $meta_key, $post_id ) {
		return current_user_can( 'edit_post', $post_id );
	};

	register_post_meta(
		POST_TYPE,
		ROLE_META,
		array(
			'type'              => 'string',
			'description'       => __( 'Role or job title of the team member.', 'team-directory' ),
			'single'            => true,
			'default'           => '',
			'sanitize_callback' => __NAMESPACE__ . '\\sanitize_role',
			'auth_callback'     => $auth_callback,
			'show_in_rest'      => array(
				'schema' => array(
					'type'      => 'string',
					'maxLength' => ROLE_MAX_LENGTH,
				),
			),
			'revisions_enabled' => true,
		)
	);

		POST_TYPE,
		START_YEAR_META,
		array(
			'type'              => 'integer',
			'description'       => __( 'Year the team member started. 0 means not set.', 'team-directory' ),

			'default'           => 0,

					'minimum' => 0,
					'maximum' => max_start_year(),
				),
			),
			'revisions_enabled' => true,
		)
	);
}

/**
 * Sanitize a role value.
 *
 * @param mixed $value Raw value.
 * @return string
 */
function sanitize_role( $value ) {
	$value = sanitize_text_field( (string) $value );

	return mb_substr( $value, 0, ROLE_MAX_LENGTH );
}

/**
 * Sanitize a start year. Values outside the allowed range become 0 (not set).
 *
 * @param mixed $value Raw value.
 * @return int
 */
function sanitize_start_year( $value ) {
	$year = absint( $value );

	if ( $year < min_start_year() || $year > max_start_year() ) {
		return 0;
	}

	return $year;
}

/**
 * Earliest accepted start year.
 *
 * @return int
 */
function min_start_year() {
	return 1900;
}

/**
 * Latest accepted start year (next year, to allow announced hires).
 *
 * @return int
 */
function max_start_year() {
	return (int) gmdate( 'Y' ) + 1;
}

/**
 * Use "Member name" as the title placeholder for team members.
 *
 * @param string   $text Default placeholder.
 * @param \WP_Post $post Current post.
 * @return string
 */
function title_placeholder( $text, $post ) {
	if ( $post instanceof \WP_Post && POST_TYPE === $post->post_type ) {
		return __( 'Member name', 'team-directory' );
	}

	return $text;
}

<?php
/**
 * Shared helpers for querying and formatting team members.
 *
 * Used by both the REST endpoint and the block's server-side render.
 *
 * @package TeamDirectory
 */

namespace Team_Directory;

defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

/**
 * Query published team members.
 *
 * @param array $args {
 *     Optional. Query arguments.
 *
 *     @type string $role     Exact role to filter by. Empty for all.
 *     @type int    $per_page Items per page (1–50).
 *     @type int    $page     Page number (1-based).
 * }
 * @return \WP_Query
 */
function query_members( array $args = array() ) {
	$args = wp_parse_args(
		$args,
		array(
			'role'     => '',
			'per_page' => 10,
			'page'     => 1,
		)
	);

	$per_page = min( MAX_PER_PAGE, max( 1, (int) $args['per_page'] ) );
	$page     = max( 1, (int) $args['page'] );

	$query_args = array(
		'post_type'           => POST_TYPE,
		'post_status'         => 'publish',
		'posts_per_page'      => $per_page,
		'paged'               => $page,
		'orderby'             => array(
			'menu_order' => 'ASC',
			'title'      => 'ASC',
		),
		'ignore_sticky_posts' => true,
		'no_found_rows'       => false,
	);

	$role = sanitize_role( $args['role'] );
	if ( '' !== $role ) {
		// phpcs:ignore WordPress.DB.SlowDBQuery.slow_db_query_meta_query -- Filtering by role is a core feature.
		$query_args['meta_query'] = array(
			array(
				'key'     => ROLE_META,
				'value'   => $role,
				'compare' => '=',
			),
		);
	}

	return new \WP_Query( $query_args );
}

<?php
/**
 * REST API endpoints for team members.
 *
 * @package TeamDirectory
 */

namespace Team_Directory;

use WP_Error;
use WP_REST_Request;
use WP_REST_Response;
use WP_REST_Server;

defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

/**
 * Registers and handles the team-directory/v1 routes.
 */
class REST_Controller {

	/**
	 * Route namespace.
	 *
	 * @var string
	 */
	const NAMESPACE = 'team-directory/v1';

	/**
	 * Register routes.
	 *
	 * @return void
	 */
	public function register_routes() {
		register_rest_route(
			self::NAMESPACE,
			'/members',
			array(
				array(
					'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
					'callback'            => array( $this, 'get_members' ),
					'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
					'args'                => $this->get_collection_args(),
				),
				'schema' => array( $this, 'get_item_schema' ),
			)
		);

		register_rest_route(
			self::NAMESPACE,
			'/members/(?P<id>\d+)/role',
			array(
				array(
					'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::EDITABLE,
					'callback'            => array( $this, 'update_role' ),
					'permission_callback' => array( $this, 'update_role_permissions_check' ),
					'args'                => array(
						'id'   => array(
							'description'       => __( 'Team member ID.', 'team-directory' ),
							'type'              => 'integer',
							'minimum'           => 1,
							'required'          => true,
							'validate_callback' => 'rest_validate_request_arg',
							'sanitize_callback' => 'absint',
						),
						'role' => array(
							'description'       => __( 'New role for the team member.', 'team-directory' ),
							'type'              => 'string',
							'required'          => true,
							'validate_callback' => array( $this, 'validate_role' ),
							'sanitize_callback' => __NAMESPACE__ . '\\sanitize_role',
						),
					),
				),
				'schema' => array( $this, 'get_item_schema' ),
			)
		);

		register_rest_route(
			self::NAMESPACE,
			'/roles',
			array(
				array(
					'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
					'callback'            => array( $this, 'get_roles' ),
					'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
				),
			)
		);
	}

	/**
	 * Arguments for the members collection.
	 *
	 * @return array
	 */
	protected function get_collection_args() {
		return array(
			'page'     => array(
				'description'       => __( 'Current page of the collection.', 'team-directory' ),
				'type'              => 'integer',
				'default'           => 1,
				'minimum'           => 1,
				'validate_callback' => 'rest_validate_request_arg',
				'sanitize_callback' => 'absint',
			),
			'per_page' => array(
				'description'       => sprintf(
					/* translators: %d: maximum number of items per page. */
					__( 'Maximum number of items to return per page (1–%d).', 'team-directory' ),
					MAX_PER_PAGE
				),
				'type'              => 'integer',
				'default'           => 10,
				'minimum'           => 1,
				'maximum'           => MAX_PER_PAGE,
				'validate_callback' => 'rest_validate_request_arg',
				'sanitize_callback' => 'absint',
			),
			'role'     => array(
				'description'       => __( 'Only return members with this exact role.', 'team-directory' ),
				'type'              => 'string',
				'default'           => '',
				'maxLength'         => ROLE_MAX_LENGTH,
				'validate_callback' => 'rest_validate_request_arg',
				'sanitize_callback' => __NAMESPACE__ . '\\sanitize_role',
			),
		);
	}

	/**
	 * GET /members.
	 *
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Request.
	 * @return WP_REST_Response|WP_Error
	 */
	public function get_members( WP_REST_Request $request ) {
		$page  = (int) $request['page'];
		$query = query_members(
			array(
				'role'     => (string) $request['role'],
				'per_page' => (int) $request['per_page'],
				'page'     => $page,
			)
		);

		$total       = (int) $query->found_posts;
		$total_pages = (int) $query->max_num_pages;

		if ( $page > 1 && $page > $total_pages ) {
			return new WP_Error(
				'team_directory_invalid_page_number',
				__( 'The page number requested is larger than the number of pages available.', 'team-directory' ),
				array( 'status' => 400 )
			);
		}

		$items = array_map( __NAMESPACE__ . '\\format_member', $query->posts );

		$response = rest_ensure_response( $items );
		$response->header( 'X-WP-Total', (string) $total );
		$response->header( 'X-WP-TotalPages', (string) $total_pages );

		$base = add_query_arg(
			urlencode_deep( array_filter( $request->get_query_params(), 'is_scalar' ) ),
			rest_url( self::NAMESPACE . '/members' )
		);
		if ( $page > 1 ) {
			$response->link_header( 'prev', add_query_arg( 'page', $page - 1, $base ) );
		}
		if ( $page < $total_pages ) {
			$response->link_header( 'next', add_query_arg( 'page', $page + 1, $base ) );
		}

		return $response;
	}

	/**
	 * GET /roles.
	 *
	 * @return WP_REST_Response
	 */
	public function get_roles() {
		return rest_ensure_response( get_member_roles() );
	}

	/**
	 * Permission check for updating a member's role.
	 *
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Request.
	 * @return true|WP_Error
	 */
	public function update_role_permissions_check( WP_REST_Request $request ) {
		$post = get_post( (int) $request['id'] );

		if ( ! $post || POST_TYPE !== $post->post_type ) {
			return new WP_Error(
				'team_directory_member_not_found',
				__( 'Team member not found.', 'team-directory' ),
				array( 'status' => 404 )
			);
		}

		if ( ! current_user_can( 'edit_post', $post->ID ) ) {
			return new WP_Error(
				'team_directory_cannot_edit',
				__( 'Sorry, you are not allowed to edit this team member.', 'team-directory' ),
				array( 'status' => rest_authorization_required_code() )
			);
		}

		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Validate the role argument.
	 *
	 * @param mixed           $value   Value.
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Request.
	 * @param string          $param   Parameter name.
	 * @return true|WP_Error
	 */
	public function validate_role( $value, $request, $param ) {
		if ( ! is_string( $value ) ) {
			return new WP_Error(
				'rest_invalid_param',
				/* translators: %s: parameter name. */
				sprintf( __( '%s must be a string.', 'team-directory' ), $param ),
				array( 'status' => 400 )
			);
		}

		$clean = sanitize_text_field( $value );

		if ( '' === $clean ) {
			return new WP_Error(
				'rest_invalid_param',
				/* translators: %s: parameter name. */
				sprintf( __( '%s must not be empty.', 'team-directory' ), $param ),
				array( 'status' => 400 )
			);
		}

		if ( mb_strlen( $clean ) > ROLE_MAX_LENGTH ) {
			return new WP_Error(
				'rest_invalid_param',
				sprintf(
					/* translators: 1: parameter name, 2: maximum length. */
					__( '%1$s must be at most %2$d characters long.', 'team-directory' ),
					$param,
					ROLE_MAX_LENGTH
				),
				array( 'status' => 400 )
			);
		}

		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * POST/PUT/PATCH /members/{id}/role.
	 *
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Request.
	 * @return WP_REST_Response|WP_Error
	 */
	public function update_role( WP_REST_Request $request ) {
		$post = get_post( (int) $request['id'] );
		$role = (string) $request['role'];

		if ( (string) get_post_meta( $post->ID, ROLE_META, true ) !== $role ) {
			$result = update_post_meta( $post->ID, ROLE_META, $role );

			if ( false === $result ) {
				return new WP_Error(
					'team_directory_update_failed',
					__( 'The role could not be saved.', 'team-directory' ),
					array( 'status' => 500 )
				);
			}
		}

		return rest_ensure_response( format_member( $post ) );
	}

	/**
	 * Schema for a team member item.
	 *
	 * @return array
	 */

		);

				'rest_invalid_param',
				/* translators: %s: parameter name. */
				sprintf( __( '%s must not be empty.', 'team-directory' ), $param ),

content.text:
I've written the Team Directory plugin to `./output/team-directory/`. Nothing has been built or run, so none of it is tested. Run `npm install && npm run build` before activating, because the block and the sidebar load from `build/`.

**How it works:**
- **Team members** are their own post type (`td_member`). The member's name is the post title, the bio is the post content (or the excerpt, if one is set), and the photo is the featured image.
- **Role and start year** are edited in a "Member details" panel in the editor's document sidebar and saved with the member. A start year outside 1900 to next year is saved as "not set" instead of being rejected; the sidebar warns about this as you type.
- **`GET /wp-json/team-directory/v1/members`** is public and only lists published members. It takes `role`, `page` and `per_page` (at most 50). The total number of members and pages is sent in the `X-WP-Total` and `X-WP-TotalPages` response headers, not in the JSON body. Asking for a page past the last one returns a 400 error.
- **`POST /wp-json/team-directory/v1/members/{id}/role`** (PUT and PATCH also work) changes one member's role. It returns 404 if the member doesn't exist and 401/403 if the user isn't allowed to edit that member. An empty or over-100-character role gets a 400 with a clear message.
- **The Team List block** shows a live preview in the editor from the endpoint, with a role filter, a spinner while loading, and an error notice if the request fails. On the front end, `render.php` renders the list on the server.

I added two things you didn't ask for: a public `GET /wp-json/team-directory/v1/roles` endpoint, which fills the block's role dropdown, and settings in the block to show or hide the photo and bio. The plugin needs WordPress 6.6 or later, because the sidebar panel uses a component that moved into `@wordpress/editor` in that version.

**Files:**
- `team-directory.php`
- `includes/post-type.php`: the member post type and the role and start-year fields
- `includes/members.php`: the member query and output code, shared by the endpoint and the block
- `includes/class-rest-controller.php`: the `members`, `members/{id}/role` and `roles` routes
- `includes/editor.php`: loads the sidebar script on the member edit screen
- `src/member-sidebar/index.js`

- `src/team-list/index.js`
- `src/team-list/edit.js`
- `src/team-list/render.php`
- `src/team-list/style.scss`
- `src/team-list/editor.scss`
- `package.json`
- `webpack.config.js`: adds the sidebar as a second build entry
